\\\"https://ref3.test/\\\",\\n \\\"https://ref2.test/\\\",\\n \\\"https://ref1.test/\\\",\\n ]\\n\\n page_one = app.stats(code, params={\\\"limit\\\": 2, \\\"offset\\\": 0}).json()\\n page_two = app.stats(code, params={\\\"limit\\\": 2, \\\"offset\\\": 2}).json()\\n assert page_one[\\\"total_clicks\\\"] == 3 and page_two[\\\"total_clicks\\\"] == 3\\n assert len(page_one[\\\"clicks\\\"]) == 2 and len(page_two[\\\"clicks\\\"]) == 1\\n\\n\\ndef test_the_clicks_table_has_no_column_capable_of_holding_a_client_address(app):\\n code = app.create_ok(\\\"https://example.com/a\\\")\\n app.visit(code)\\n\\n for column in app.columns(\\\"clicks\\\"):\\n low = column.lower()\\n assert \\\"ip\\\" not in low, column\\n assert \\\"addr\\\" not in low, column\\n assert \\\"remote\\\" not in low, column\\n assert \\\"client\\\" not in low, column\\n\"}],\"coverage_notes\":\"tests/test_round_trip.py pins the create->follow round trip (201 body shape, 7-char base62 code, short_url built from LINKS_BASE_URL with the trailing slash stripped, 307 + exact Location + Cache-Control: no-store) and LINKS_CODE_LENGTH. tests/test_open_redirect.py covers javascript:, data: and file: (plus case variants and protocol-relative/ftp/mailto) rejected with 400 unsupported_scheme and asserts the links table is empty afterwards, with a positive control that http/https still succeed. tests/test_blocked_destinations.py covers 169.254.169.254, other link-local, loopback (v4, v6, and the 2130706433 decimal literal), 10/172.16/192.168, fd00::/7 and 0.0.0.0, plus hostnames resolving to metadata/loopback/mixed sets and an unresolvable host failing closed - each asserting 400 blocked_destination and zero rows. tests/test_expiry.py uses a direct DB write of a past expires_at (never sleeps) for 410 link_expired with no Location and no click row, distinguishes 410 from 404, rejects past/unparseable expires_at with no row, and checks the configured default TTL. tests/test_rate_limit.py drives the per-IP creation bucket past LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_MAX (429 rate_limited, Retry-After whole seconds 1..60, Cache-Control no-store, no row written), shows a different client key still gets 201, honours LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_MAX/LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED, and reopens the window by advancing an injected fake clock (patched onto app.ratelimit's time reference). tests/test_api_key_rate_limit.py covers every SHORTENER_API_KEYS acceptance criterion: alpha 100/101st 429 with no row, independent alpha/beta buckets, no double-charging of the per-IP bucket at MAX=2, unknown key falling back with no 401/403, anonymous legacy behaviour, Retry-After format, window rollover via the fake clock, redirects still served at MAX*100 after the creation quota is spent, stats never limited, unset keys unchanged, the malformed 'alpha,beta:abc,gamma:0,:5,delta:20' list, whitespace trimming, case sensitivity, disabled limiter, schema/table/disk-bytes containment, and no key echo in body/headers/DEBUG logs. tests/test_code_collision.py forces the generator to return an existing code (patching app.main.generate_code and app.codes.generate_code) and pins retry-to-uniqueness plus a bounded LINKS_CODE_MAX_ATTEMPTS=3 giving 503 code_generation_failed with exactly three attempts (no hang, no 500). tests/test_unknown_code.py pins 404 not_found for unknown/malformed codes and stats, creating nothing. tests/test_click_analytics.py pins one increment per successful redirect, no increment on 404 or 410, per-link attribution, referrer/user-agent capture, paging, and the absence of any IP-shaped column.\\n\\nDESIGN vs IMPLEMENTATION mismatches (findings; tests follow the implementation as instructed): (1) The shipped code contains no SHORTENER_API_KEYS support at all - app/config.Settings has no api_key_quotas and app/ratelimit only keys on the client address - so every test in tests/test_api_key_rate_limit.py will fail until the feature lands. (2) TTL configuration differs: design says LINKS_DEFAULT_TTL_SECONDS/LINKS_MAX_TTL_SECONDS with a ttl_seconds request field and NULL = never expires; the code uses LINKS_DEFAULT_TTL_DAYS (default 30) and an ISO-8601 expires_at body field with a NOT NULL expires_at column. Tests use the implementation's names. (3) links schema differs: design specifies target_url/click_count/last_clicked_at; the code stores url and derives totals from the clicks table, so the column assertions pin id,code,url,created_at,expires_at and id,link_id,clicked_at,referrer,user_agent. (4) LINKS_DB_PATH default is ./links.db in code vs ./data/links.db in the design; tests always set it explicitly. (5) LINKS_MAX_TRACKED_KEYS is not read by the code (a hard-coded MAX_TRACKED_KEYS = 20000 is used) and the code adds LINKS_TRUST_FORWARDED_FOR, LINKS_DNS_RESOLUTION_ENABLED, LINKS_STATS_* which the design omits; the limiter clock is not injectable, so the window tests patch app.ratelimit.time and will need updating if an injected clock replaces it. (6) The design's clock injection and LRU bucket-map separation, the 2048-char URL limit boundary, and health/stats validation edge cases are deliberately not covered here beyond what the listed criteria require; no test asserts log output.\"}", "tier": "deep"}

56+1178.74smodel_callimplement{"cassette_key": "a6713fecfecf6ef5", "cost_usd": 1.284385, "from_replay": false, "input_tokens": 8272, "latency_seconds": 504.618801, "model": "claude-opus-5", "output_tokens": 49721, "parsed": {"files": [{"content": "# Runtime dependencies (pinned exactly as required by the design).\nfastapi==0.115.6\nstarlette==0.41.3\npydantic==2.10.4\nuvicorn==0.32.1\n\n# Test-time tooling. starlette.testclient requires httpx at import time; the\n# service itself imports neither of these packages.\nhttpx==0.28.1\npytest==8.3.4\n", "path": "requirements.txt"}, {"content": "# URL shortener\n\nA small FastAPI + SQLite URL shortener with SSRF-hardened target validation,\nfixed-window rate limiting in ASGI middleware, and per-API-key creation quotas.\n\n## Run\n\n```bash\npip install -r requirements.txt\nuvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000\n```\n\n## Endpoints\n\n| Method | Path | Notes |\n|--------|-----------------------------|----------------------------------------------------|\n| GET | `/health` | Liveness only, never touches user data, not limited |\n| POST | `/api/links` | Creates a link. Rate limited (per key or per IP). |\n| GET | `/{code}` | 307 redirect to the stored target. Per-IP limited. |\n| GET | `/api/links/{code}/stats` | Click statistics. Never rate limited. |\n\nAll errors use the stable envelope `{\"error\": {\"code\": ..., \"message\": ...}}`.\n\n## Configuration\n\n| Variable | Default | Purpose |\n|---------------------------------|------------------------|---------|\n| `LINKS_DB_PATH` | `./data/links.db` | SQLite file (WAL). |\n| `LINKS_BASE_URL` | `http://localhost:8000`| Origin for `short_url`; trailing slash stripped. |\n| `LINKS_CODE_LENGTH` | `7` | Base62 code length, 4..16 else 7. |\n| `LINKS_CODE_MAX_ATTEMPTS` | `5` | Insert attempts on code collision. |\n| `LINKS_MAX_URL_LENGTH` | `2048` | Max accepted target url length. |\n| `LINKS_DEFAULT_TTL_SECONDS` | `0` | 0 means never expires. |\n| `LINKS_MAX_TTL_SECONDS` | `31536000` | Upper bound for `ttl_seconds`. |\n| `LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED` | `true` | Master switch for the limiter. |\n| `LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_MAX` | `10` | Per-IP creation budget; redirects get x100. |\n| `LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SECONDS`| `60` | Fixed window length and Retry-After clamp. |\n| `LINKS_MAX_TRACKED_KEYS` | `10000` | LRU cap, applied per bucket map. |\n| `LINKS_LOG_LEVEL` | `INFO` | Log level. |\n| `SHORTENER_API_KEYS` | *(empty)* | `name:quota` pairs, comma separated. |\n\nAPI key values are never persisted, never logged and never echoed in a response.\n", "path": "README.md"}, {"content": "\"\"\"URL shortener application package.\"\"\"\n\n__all__ = [\"__version__\"]\n\n__version__ = \"1.1.0\"\n", "path": "app/__init__.py"}, {"content": "\"\"\"Environment driven configuration for the URL shortener.\n\nAll settings are read exactly once into an immutable :class:`Settings` snapshot\nat application construction. Parsing always fails safe: an unusable value is\nlogged and degraded to the documented default rather than raising.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport logging\nimport os\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom types import MappingProxyType\nfrom typing import Mapping, Optional\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(\"app.config\")\n\n_TRUE_VALUES = frozenset({\"true\", \"1\", \"yes\", \"on\"})\n_VALID_LOG_LEVELS = frozenset({\"CRITICAL\", \"ERROR\", \"WARNING\", \"INFO\", \"DEBUG\", \"NOTSET\"})\n\n# Hard ceilings applied on top of the documented defaults so that a hostile or\n# fat-fingered environment cannot push the process into pathological ranges.\n_MAX_URL_LENGTH_CEILING = 8192\n_MAX_API_KEY_NAME_LENGTH = 128\n_MAX_API_KEY_QUOTA = 1_000_000\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Settings:\n \"\"\"Immutable snapshot of the process configuration.\n\n Attributes mirror the environment variables documented in the README. The\n instance is frozen so that no request handler can mutate configuration.\n \"\"\"\n\n db_path: str\n base_url: str\n code_length: int\n code_max_attempts: int\n max_url_length: int\n default_ttl_seconds: int\n max_ttl_seconds: int\n rate_limit_enabled: bool\n rate_limit_max: int\n rate_limit_window_seconds: int\n max_tracked_keys: int\n log_level: str\n api_key_quotas: Mapping[str, int]\n\n\ndef _read_str(env: Mapping[str, str], name: str, default: str) -> str:\n \"\"\"Read a string environment variable.\n\n Returns the trimmed value, or ``default`` when the variable is unset or\n blank. Raises nothing.\n \"\"\"\n raw = env.get(name)\n if raw is None:\n return default\n value = raw.strip()\n return value if value else default\n\n\ndef _read_int(\n env: Mapping[str, str],\n name: str,\n default: int,\n minimum: int,\n maximum: int,\n) -> int:\n \"\"\"Read an integer environment variable with range enforcement.\n\n Returns the parsed value when it is an integer inside ``[minimum, maximum]``,\n otherwise logs a warning and returns ``default``. Raises nothing.\n \"\"\"\n raw = env.get(name)\n if raw is None or not raw.strip():\n return default\n try:\n value = int(raw.strip())\n except ValueError:\n logger.warning(\"%s is not an integer; using default %d\", name, default)\n return default\n if value < minimum or value > maximum:\n logger.warning(\n \"%s=%d is outside the accepted range %d..%d; using default %d\",\n name,\n value,\n minimum,\n maximum,\n default,\n )\n return default\n return value\n\n\ndef _read_bool(env: Mapping[str, str], name: str, default: bool) -> bool:\n \"\"\"Read a boolean environment variable.\n\n Returns True when the trimmed, lower-cased value is one of\n ``true``/``1``/``yes``/``on``; returns ``default`` when unset or blank and\n False otherwise. Raises nothing.\n \"\"\"\n raw = env.get(name)\n if raw is None or not raw.strip():\n return default\n return raw.strip().lower() in _TRUE_VALUES\n\n\ndef parse_api_key_quotas(raw: Optional[str]) -> Mapping[str, int]:\n \"\"\"Parse ``SHORTENER_API_KEYS`` into an immutable name -> quota mapping.\n\n Accepts a comma separated list of ``name:quota`` pairs with arbitrary\n surrounding whitespace. Returns an empty mapping when the value is unset,\n empty or wholly unparsable. Malformed entries are counted and reported\n without ever logging the offending value, because entries may be\n credentials. Raises nothing.\n \"\"\"\n quotas: \"dict[str, int]\" = {}\n skipped = 0\n if raw:\n for chunk in raw.split(\",\"):\n item = chunk.strip()\n if not item:\n continue\n name, separator, quota_raw = item.partition(\":\")\n name = name.strip()\n quota_raw = quota_raw.strip()\n if not separator or not name or not quota_raw:\n skipped += 1\n continue\n if len(name) > _MAX_API_KEY_NAME_LENGTH:\n skipped += 1\n continue\n try:\n quota = int(quota_raw)\n except ValueError:\n skipped += 1\n continue\n if quota < 1 or quota > _MAX_API_KEY_QUOTA:\n skipped += 1\n continue\n quotas[name] = quota\n if skipped:\n logger.warning(\n \"Ignored %d malformed entr%s in SHORTENER_API_KEYS\",\n skipped,\n \"y\" if skipped == 1 else \"ies\",\n )\n return MappingProxyType(dict(quotas))\n\n\ndef load_settings(env: Optional[Mapping[str, str]] = None) -> Settings:\n \"\"\"Build the frozen settings snapshot from the environment.\n\n ``env`` defaults to ``os.environ``. Returns a fully populated\n :class:`Settings`. Raises nothing: every unusable value degrades to its\n documented default with a warning.\n \"\"\"\n source: Mapping[str, str] = env if env is not None else os.environ\n\n db_path = _read_str(source, \"LINKS_DB_PATH\", \"./data/links.db\")\n base_url = _read_str(source, \"LINKS_BASE_URL\", \"http://localhost:8000\").rstrip(\"/\")\n if not base_url:\n base_url = \"http://localhost:8000\"\n\n log_level_raw = _read_str(source, \"LINKS_LOG_LEVEL\", \"INFO\").upper()\n if log_level_raw not in _VALID_LOG_LEVELS:\n logger.warning(\"LINKS_LOG_LEVEL is not a known level; using INFO\")\n log_level_raw = \"INFO\"\n\n max_ttl_seconds = _read_int(source, \"LINKS_MAX_TTL_SECONDS\", 31_536_000, 1, 1_000_000_000)\n default_ttl_seconds = _read_int(source, \"LINKS_DEFAULT_TTL_SECONDS\", 0, 0, 1_000_000_000)\n\n return Settings(\n db_path=db_path,\n base_url=base_url,\n code_length=_read_int(source, \"LINKS_CODE_LENGTH\", 7, 4, 16),\n code_max_attempts=_read_int(source, \"LINKS_CODE_MAX_ATTEMPTS\", 5, 1, 100),\n max_url_length=_read_int(\n source, \"LINKS_MAX_URL_LENGTH\", 2048, 1, _MAX_URL_LENGTH_CEILING\n ),\n default_ttl_seconds=default_ttl_seconds,\n max_ttl_seconds=max_ttl_seconds,\n rate_limit_enabled=_read_bool(source, \"LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED\", True),\n rate_limit_max=_read_int(source, \"LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_MAX\", 10, 1, 1_000_000),\n rate_limit_window_seconds=_read_int(\n source, \"LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SECONDS\", 60, 1, 3600\n ),\n max_tracked_keys=_read_int(source, \"LINKS_MAX_TRACKED_KEYS\", 10_000, 1, 1_000_000),\n log_level=log_level_raw,\n api_key_quotas=parse_api_key_quotas(source.get(\"SHORTENER_API_KEYS\")),\n )\n", "path": "app/config.py"}, {"content": "\"\"\"Stable error envelope helpers.\n\nEvery error the service emits has the shape\n``{\"error\": {\"code\": \"...\", \"message\": \"...\"}}``. No stack trace, database error\nstring or filesystem path ever reaches a client.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Dict, Mapping, Optional\n\nfrom fastapi.responses import JSONResponse\n\nMAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH = 500\n\n\nclass AppError(Exception):\n \"\"\"Application level error carrying an HTTP status and a stable error code.\"\"\"\n\n def __init__(\n self,\n status_code: int,\n code: str,\n message: str,\n headers: Optional[Mapping[str, str]] = None,\n ) -> None:\n \"\"\"Create an error.\n\n ``status_code`` is the HTTP status, ``code`` the stable machine readable\n identifier, ``message`` a safe human readable description and\n ``headers`` optional extra response headers. Raises nothing.\n \"\"\"\n super().__init__(message)\n self.status_code = status_code\n self.code = code\n self.message = message[:MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH]\n self.headers: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = dict(headers) if headers else None\n\n\ndef error_payload(code: str, message: str) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, str]]:\n \"\"\"Build the error envelope body.\n\n Returns the dictionary that is serialised as the JSON error response.\n Raises nothing.\n \"\"\"\n return {\"error\": {\"code\": code, \"message\": message[:MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH]}}\n\n\ndef error_response(\n status_code: int,\n code: str,\n message: str,\n headers: Optional[Mapping[str, str]] = None,\n) -> JSONResponse:\n \"\"\"Build a JSON error response using the stable envelope.\n\n Returns a :class:`JSONResponse` with the given status, envelope body and\n optional headers. Raises nothing.\n \"\"\"\n return JSONResponse(\n status_code=status_code,\n content=error_payload(code, message),\n headers=dict(headers) if headers else None,\n )\n", "path": "app/errors.py"}, {"content": "\"\"\"Small shared helpers: short code generation, time formatting, truncation.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport secrets\nimport string\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\nfrom typing import Optional\n\nBASE62_ALPHABET = string.digits + string.ascii_uppercase + string.ascii_lowercase\n\n# Codes accepted on the read paths. Generated codes are a strict subset.\nCODE_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"^[0-9A-Za-z]{1,64}$\")\n\n\ndef generate_code(length: int) -> str:\n \"\"\"Generate a cryptographically random base62 short code.\n\n Returns a string of exactly ``length`` characters. Raises ValueError when\n ``length`` is not positive.\n \"\"\"\n if length <= 0:\n raise ValueError(\"code length must be positive\")\n return \"\".join(secrets.choice(BASE62_ALPHABET) for _ in range(length))\n\n\ndef utc_now() -> datetime:\n \"\"\"Return the current time as a timezone aware UTC datetime.\n\n Raises nothing.\n \"\"\"\n return datetime.now(timezone.utc)\n\n\ndef to_rfc3339(value: datetime) -> str:\n \"\"\"Format a datetime as a fixed width RFC3339 UTC string.\n\n Naive datetimes are treated as UTC. The fixed width (microsecond precision,\n trailing ``Z``) makes lexicographic comparison equivalent to chronological\n comparison, which is what the expiry check relies on. Returns the formatted\n string. Raises nothing.\n \"\"\"\n if value.tzinfo is None:\n value = value.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)\n return value.astimezone(timezone.utc).strftime(\"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f\") + \"Z\"\n\n\ndef truncate(value: Optional[str], limit: int) -> Optional[str]:\n \"\"\"Truncate an optional string to ``limit`` characters.\n\n Returns None when ``value`` is None, otherwise the (possibly shortened)\n string. Raises nothing.\n \"\"\"\n if value is None:\n return None\n return value[:limit]\n", "path": "app/utils.py"}, {"content": "\"\"\"SQLite access layer.\n\nThe schema is frozen: ``SCHEMA_STATEMENTS`` defines exactly two tables and one\nindex, and nothing in this service writes client addresses or API keys to disk.\nEvery statement is parameterised; no SQL is ever built by string formatting.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport sqlite3\nfrom contextlib import contextmanager\nfrom typing import Iterator, Optional, Tuple\n\nSCHEMA_STATEMENTS: Tuple[str, ...] = (\n \"\"\"\n CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS links (\n id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n target_url TEXT NOT NULL,\n created_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n expires_at TEXT,\n click_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n last_clicked_at TEXT\n )\n \"\"\",\n \"\"\"\n CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS clicks (\n id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n link_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES links(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n clicked_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n referrer TEXT,\n user_agent TEXT\n )\n \"\"\",\n \"CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_clicks_link_id ON clicks(link_id)\",\n)\n\nMAX_TEXT_FIELD_LENGTH = 512\n\n\ndef ensure_parent_directory(db_path: str) -> None:\n \"\"\"Create the directory holding the SQLite file when it does not exist.\n\n Does nothing for in-memory databases or paths without a directory part.\n Returns None. Raises OSError when the directory cannot be created.\n \"\"\"\n if db_path == \":memory:\" or db_path.startswith(\"file:\"):\n return\n parent = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(db_path))\n if parent:\n os.makedirs(parent, exist_ok=True)\n\n\n@contextmanager\ndef connect(db_path: str) -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:\n \"\"\"Open a SQLite connection configured for WAL and foreign keys.\n\n Yields the connection and always closes it. Raises sqlite3.Error when the\n database cannot be opened or configured.\n \"\"\"\n conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path, timeout=5.0, isolation_level=None)\n try:\n conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n conn.execute(\"PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL\")\n conn.execute(\"PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON\")\n conn.execute(\"PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000\")\n yield conn\n finally:\n conn.close()\n\n\n@contextmanager\ndef transaction(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:\n \"\"\"Run a block inside an immediate SQLite transaction.\n\n Yields the connection, commits on success and rolls back on any exception.\n Raises whatever the wrapped block raises, including sqlite3.IntegrityError.\n \"\"\"\n conn.execute(\"BEGIN IMMEDIATE\")\n try:\n yield conn\n except BaseException:\n conn.execute(\"ROLLBACK\")\n raise\n conn.execute(\"COMMIT\")\n\n\ndef init_db(db_path: str) -> None:\n \"\"\"Create the schema if it is missing.\n\n Returns None. Raises sqlite3.Error when the schema cannot be applied and\n OSError when the parent directory cannot be created.\n \"\"\"\n ensure_parent_directory(db_path)\n with connect(db_path) as conn:\n for statement in SCHEMA_STATEMENTS:\n conn.execute(statement)\n\n\ndef insert_link(\n conn: sqlite3.Connection,\n code: str,\n target_url: str,\n created_at: str,\n expires_at: Optional[str],\n) -> int:\n \"\"\"Insert a new link row.\n\n Returns the new row id. Raises sqlite3.IntegrityError when ``code``\n collides with an existing row (the UNIQUE constraint is the only place code\n uniqueness is enforced).\n \"\"\"\n with transaction(conn):\n cursor = conn.execute(\n \"INSERT INTO links (code, target_url, created_at, expires_at, click_count, \"\n \"last_clicked_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 0, NULL)\",\n (code, target_url, created_at, expires_at),\n )\n row_id = cursor.lastrowid\n return int(row_id or 0)\n\n\ndef fetch_link(conn: sqlite3.Connection, code: str) -> Optional[sqlite3.Row]:\n \"\"\"Look up a single link by its short code.\n\n Returns the row, or None when no link with that code exists. Raises\n sqlite3.Error on database failure.\n \"\"\"\n cursor = conn.execute(\n \"SELECT id, code, target_url, created_at, expires_at, click_count, last_clicked_at \"\n \"FROM links WHERE code = ?\",\n (code,),\n )\n return cursor.fetchone()\n\n\ndef record_click(\n conn: sqlite3.Connection,\n link_id: int,\n clicked_at: str,\n referrer: Optional[str],\n user_agent: Optional[str],\n) -> None:\n \"\"\"Record a redirect: bump the counter and append to the click log.\n\n Deliberately stores no client address and no API key. Returns None. Raises\n sqlite3.Error on database failure.\n \"\"\"\n with transaction(conn):\n conn.execute(\n \"UPDATE links SET click_count = click_count + 1, last_clicked_at = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n (clicked_at, link_id),\n )\n conn.execute(\n \"INSERT INTO clicks (link_id, clicked_at, referrer, user_agent) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n (\n link_id,\n clicked_at,\n referrer[:MAX_TEXT_FIELD_LENGTH] if referrer is not None else None,\n user_agent[:MAX_TEXT_FIELD_LENGTH] if user_agent is not None else None,\n ),\n )\n", "path": "app/db.py"}, {"content": "\"\"\"Typed request and response models validated at the HTTP boundary.\n\nThe request model runs in pydantic strict mode: values of the wrong type are\nrejected rather than coerced, and unknown fields are refused.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Optional\n\nfrom pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field\n\n# Absolute ceiling for the url field. The per-deployment limit\n# (LINKS_MAX_URL_LENGTH) is applied on top of this in the route and can only be\n# smaller, so nothing longer than this ever reaches the database.\nMAX_URL_FIELD_LENGTH = 8192\nMAX_TTL_FIELD_VALUE = 1_000_000_000\n\n\nclass CreateLinkRequest(BaseModel):\n \"\"\"Body of ``POST /api/links``.\"\"\"\n\n model_config = ConfigDict(extra=\"forbid\", strict=True)\n\n url: str = Field(\n ...,\n min_length=1,\n max_length=MAX_URL_FIELD_LENGTH,\n description=\"Absolute http or https target URL.\",\n )\n ttl_seconds: Optional[int] = Field(\n default=None,\n ge=0,\n le=MAX_TTL_FIELD_VALUE,\n description=\"Lifetime in seconds. 0 or omitted uses the configured default.\",\n )\n\n\nclass CreateLinkResponse(BaseModel):\n \"\"\"Body of a successful ``POST /api/links``.\"\"\"\n\n code: str\n short_url: str\n target_url: str\n created_at: str\n expires_at: Optional[str] = None\n\n\nclass StatsResponse(BaseModel):\n \"\"\"Body of ``GET /api/links/{code}/stats``.\"\"\"\n\n code: str\n target_url: str\n created_at: str\n expires_at: Optional[str] = None\n click_count: int\n last_clicked_at: Optional[str] = None\n\n\nclass HealthResponse(BaseModel):\n \"\"\"Body of ``GET /health``.\"\"\"\n\n status: str\n service: str\n time: str\n", "path": "app/models.py"}, {"content": "\"\"\"Validation of user supplied target URLs.\n\nA URL is only stored after it passes every check here, and the stored value is\nexactly what is later served as a redirect ``Location``, so nothing that skipped\nvalidation can be reached.\n\nPolicy:\n * only the ``http`` and ``https`` schemes are accepted, by allow-list;\n * embedded credentials are rejected;\n * the host is resolved and every resolved address must be a global unicast\n address. Loopback, private, link-local, multicast, reserved and unspecified\n addresses are rejected, with 169.254.169.254 (the cloud metadata endpoint)\n denied explicitly.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport ipaddress\nimport logging\nimport socket\nfrom typing import List, Union\nfrom urllib.parse import urlsplit, urlunsplit\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(\"app.urls\")\n\nALLOWED_SCHEMES = frozenset({\"http\", \"https\"})\n\n# Cloud metadata endpoints. 169.254.169.254 is already covered by the\n# link-local rule but is denied by name because reaching it is how a URL\n# handler becomes a credential leak.\nMETADATA_ADDRESSES = frozenset({\"169.254.169.254\", \"fd00:ec2::254\"})\n\nMAX_HOSTNAME_LENGTH = 253\n\nIPAddress = Union[ipaddress.IPv4Address, ipaddress.IPv6Address]\n\n\nclass InvalidURLError(ValueError):\n \"\"\"Raised when a target URL may not be stored or served.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _normalise_ip(ip: IPAddress) -> IPAddress:\n \"\"\"Unwrap IPv4-in-IPv6 representations.\n\n Returns the embedded IPv4 address for mapped and 6to4 addresses, otherwise\n the address unchanged. Raises nothing.\n \"\"\"\n if isinstance(ip, ipaddress.IPv6Address):\n if ip.ipv4_mapped is not None:\n return ip.ipv4_mapped\n if ip.sixtofour is not None:\n return ip.sixtofour\n return ip\n\n\ndef is_forbidden_address(ip: IPAddress) -> bool:\n \"\"\"Report whether an IP address must not be used as a redirect target.\n\n Returns True for loopback, private, link-local, multicast, reserved,\n unspecified, metadata and any other non globally routable address. OSError) as exc:\n raise InvalidURLError(\"The host of the target url could not be resolved.\") from exc\n addresses: List[str] = []\n for info in infos:\n sockaddr = info[4]\n if not sockaddr:\n continue\n address = sockaddr[0]\n if isinstance(address, str) and address:\n addresses.append(address.split(\"%\", 1)[0])\n if not addresses:\n raise InvalidURLError(\"The host of the target url could not be resolved.\")\n return addresses\n\n\ndef validate_target_url(raw: str, max_length: int) -> str:\n \"\"\"Validate and normalise a user supplied target URL.\n\n Returns the normalised address, used for the anonymous\n creation budget (``LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_MAX``) and for redirects\n (``LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_MAX * REDIRECT_LIMIT_MULTIPLIER``).\n\n``api_key_buckets``\n keyed on a per-boot salted hash of a recognised ``X-API-Key`` value, used\n for that key's own creation quota.\n\nEach map is pruned independently at ``LINKS_MAX_TRACKED_KEYS`` entries, so API\nkey traffic cannot evict per-IP buckets. Identities are never stored or logged\nin the clear: bucket ids are ``class:blake2s(boot_salt || value)[:16]``.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hashlib\nimport logging\nimport math\nimport re\nimport secrets\nimport threading\nimport time\nfrom collections import OrderedDict\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom typing import Callable, Optional, Tuple\n\nfrom starlette.responses import JSONResponse\nfrom starlette.types import ASGIApp, Receive, Scope, Send\n\nfrom .config import Settings\nfrom .errors import error_payload\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(\"app.ratelimit\")\n\n# Redirects are far cheaper than creations and are shared by every visitor of a\n# link, so the redirect bucket is a large multiple of the creation budget.\nREDIRECT_LIMIT_MULTIPLIER = 100\n\nCREATE_PATH = \"/api/links\"\nBUCKET_CLASS_CREATE = \"create\"\nBUCKET_CLASS_CREATE_KEY = \"create_key\"\nBUCKET_CLASS_REDIRECT = \"redirect\"\n\nAPI_KEY_HEADER = b\"x-api-key\"\nMAX_API_KEY_HEADER_LENGTH = 256\n\n_REDIRECT_PATH_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"^/[0-9A-Za-z_-]{1,64}$\")\n_RESERVED_PATHS = frozenset({\"/health\", \"/docs\", \"/redoc\", \"/openapi\", \"/favicon\"})\n\n\ndef _default_clock() -> float:\n \"\"\"Return the current monotonic time in seconds.\n\n Looked up through the ``time`` module on every call so tests can patch it.\n Raises nothing.\n \"\"\"\n return time.monotonic()\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Decision:\n \"\"\"Outcome of a limiter check.\"\"\"\n\n allowed: bool\n retry_after: int\n bucket_id: str\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass BucketPlan:\n \"\"\"Which bucket a request is charged to, and at what limit.\"\"\"\n\n bucket_class: str\n identity: str\n limit: int\n keyed: bool\n\n\nclass RateLimiterState:\n \"\"\"In-process fixed-window counters shared by every worker thread.\n\n State is never serialised to SQLite, the WAL or any file.\n \"\"\"\n\n def __init__(self, settings: Settings, clock: Optional[Callable[[], float]] = None) -> None:\n \"\"\"Create limiter state for a settings snapshot.\n\n ``clock`` is an injectable monotonic time source (defaults to\n ``time.monotonic``) so tests can advance the window without sleeping.\n Raises nothing.\n \"\"\"\n self.settings = settings\n self.clock: Callable[[], float] = clock if clock is not None else _default_clock\n self._lock = threading.Lock()\n self._boot_salt = secrets.token_bytes(16)\n self.ip_buckets: \"OrderedDict[str, Tuple[float, int]]\" = OrderedDict()\n self.api_key_buckets: \"OrderedDict[str, Tuple[float, int]]\" = OrderedDict()\n\n def bucket_id(self, bucket_class: str, identity: str) -> str:\n \"\"\"Derive the opaque bucket id for an identity.\n\n Returns ``class:digest`` where digest is a truncated blake2s over the\n per-boot salt and the identity, so neither an API key nor a client\n address can be recovered from limiter state or logs. Raises nothing.\n \"\"\"\n digest = hashlib.blake2s(\n self._boot_salt + identity.encode(\"utf-8\", \"replace\")\n ).hexdigest()[:16]\n return \"%s:%s\" % (bucket_class, digest)\n\n def _prune(self, buckets: \"OrderedDict[str, Tuple[float, int]]\") -> None:\n \"\"\"Evict least recently used entries beyond the configured cap.\n\n Returns None. Raises nothing. Caller must hold the lock.\n \"\"\"\n limit = self.settings.max_tracked_keys\n while len(buckets) > limit:\n buckets.popitem(last=False)\n\n def consume(self, plan: BucketPlan) -> Decision:\n \"\"\"Charge one request against the planned bucket.\n\n Returns a :class:`Decision`; when it is not allowed, ``retry_after`` is\n a whole number of seconds in ``[1, window]``. Raises nothing.\n \"\"\"\n buckets = self.api_key_buckets if plan.keyed else self.ip_buckets\n bucket_id = self.bucket_id(plan.bucket_class, plan.identity)\n window = float(self.settings.rate_limit_window_seconds)\n with self._lock:\n now = float(self.clock())\n entry = buckets.get(bucket_id)\n if entry is None or (now - entry[0]) >= window or (now - entry[0]) < 0:\n buckets[bucket_id] = (now, 1)\n buckets.move_to_end(bucket_id)\n self._prune(buckets)\n return Decision(True, 0, bucket_id)\n window_start, count = entry\n if count >= plan.limit:\n remaining = window - (now - window_start)\n retry_after = max(1, min(int(window), int(math.ceil(remaining))))\n return Decision(False, retry_after, bucket_id)\n buckets[bucket_id] = (window_start, count + 1)\n buckets.move_to_end(bucket_id)\n return Decision(True, 0, bucket_id)\n\n def advance(self, seconds: float) -> None:\n \"\"\"Pretend ``seconds`` have elapsed by rewinding every window start.\n\n Intended for tests that must cross a window boundary without sleeping.\n Returns None. Raises nothing.\n \"\"\"\n with self._lock:\n for buckets in (self.ip_buckets, self.api_key_buckets):\n for bucket_id, (window_start, count) in list(buckets.items()):\n buckets[bucket_id] = (window_start - seconds, count)\n\n def reset(self) -> None:\n \"\"\"Drop all counters.\n\n Returns None. Raises nothing.\n \"\"\"\n with self._lock:\n self.ip_buckets.clear()\n self.api_key_buckets.clear()\n\n\ndef _header_value(scope: Scope, name: bytes) -> Optional[str]:\n \"\"\"Read a single request header from the raw ASGI scope.\n\n Returns the trimmed value of the first matching header, or None when the\n header is absent or undecodable. Raises nothing.\n \"\"\"\n for raw_name, raw_value in scope.get(\"headers\") or ():\n if raw_name == name:\n try:\n return raw_value.decode(\"latin-1\").strip()\n except (UnicodeDecodeError, AttributeError):\n return None\n return None\n\n\ndef _client_identity(scope: Scope) -> str:\n \"\"\"Return the peer address used as the per-IP limiter identity.\n\n Only the transport peer is used; forwarded headers are ignored because a\n client can trivially forge them. Returns ``\"unknown\"`` when the server does\n not expose a peer. Raises nothing.\n \"\"\"\n client = scope.get(\"client\")\n if client and isinstance(client, (tuple, list)) and client[0]:\n return str(client[0])\n return \"unknown\"\n\n\ndef _is_redirect_path(path: str) -> bool:\n \"\"\"Report whether a path is a short-code redirect path.\n\n Returns True for single segment code-shaped paths that are not reserved\n application paths. Raises nothing.\n \"\"\"\n if not _REDIRECT_PATH_PATTERN.match(path):\n return False\n return path not in _RESERVED_PATHS\n\n\nclass RateLimitMiddleware:\n \"\"\"ASGI middleware applying the creation and redirect rate limits.\"\"\"\n\n def __init__(self, app: ASGIApp, state: RateLimiterState) -> None:\n \"\"\"Wrap ``app`` with the limiter backed by ``state``.\n\n Raises nothing.\n \"\"\"\n self.app = app\n self.state = state\n\n def plan(self, scope: Scope) -> Optional[BucketPlan]:\n \"\"\"Decide which bucket, if any, this request is charged to.\n\n Creation requests presenting a recognised ``X-API-Key`` are charged\n solely to that key's bucket at that key's quota; every other creation\n request is charged to the per-IP creation bucket. Redirects are always\n charged to the per-IP redirect bucket. Returns None for requests that\n are not rate limited (health, stats, docs, everything else). Raises\n nothing.\n \"\"\"\n settings = self.state.settings\n method = scope.get(\"method\", \"\")\n path = scope.get(\"path\", \"\")\n if method == \"POST\" and path == CREATE_PATH:\n quotas = settings.api_key_quotas\n if quotas:\n presented = _header_value(scope, API_KEY_HEADER)\n if (\n presented\n and len(presented) <= MAX_API_KEY_HEADER_LENGTH\n and presented in quotas\n ):\n return BucketPlan(\n bucket_class=BUCKET_CLASS_CREATE_KEY,\n identity=presented,\n limit=int(quotas[presented]),\n keyed=True,\n )\n return BucketPlan(\n bucket_class=BUCKET_CLASS_CREATE,\n identity=_client_identity(scope),\n limit=settings.rate_limit_max,\n keyed=False,\n )\n if method in (\"GET\", \"HEAD\") and _is_redirect_path(path):\n return BucketPlan(\n bucket_class=BUCKET_CLASS_REDIRECT,\n identity=_client_identity(scope),\n limit=settings.rate_limit_max * REDIRECT_LIMIT_MULTIPLIER,\n keyed=False,\n )\n return None\n\n async def __call__(self, scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:\n \"\"\"Apply the limit and either forward the request or answer with 429.\n\n Returns None. Raises whatever the wrapped application raises.\n \"\"\"\n if scope.get(\"type\") != \"http\" or not self.state.settings.rate_limit_enabled:\n await self.app(scope, receive, send)\n return\n\n plan = self.plan(scope)\n if plan is None:\n await self.app(scope, receive, send)\n return\n\n decision = self.state.consume(plan)\n logger.debug(\n \"rate limit check bucket=%s allowed=%s\", decision.bucket_id, decision.allowed\n )\n if decision.allowed:\n await self.app(scope, receive, send)\n return\n\n response = JSONResponse(\n status_code=429,\n content=error_payload(\n \"rate_limited\", \"Rate limit exceeded.
