= urlunsplit((scheme, netloc, parts.path, parts.query, parts.fragment))\\n if len(normalised) > max_length:\\n raise InvalidURLError(\\n \\\"The target url exceeds the maximum length of %d characters.\\\" % max_length\\n )\\n return normalised\\n\"},{\"path\":\"app/ratelimit.py\",\"content\":\"\\\"\\\"\\\"Fixed-window rate limiting, enforced once in ASGI middleware.\\n\\nThe middleware runs ahead of routing and body parsing, so a throttled request\\nnever opens a database connection and never has its body read.\\n\\nTwo structurally identical but separate bucket maps are kept:\\n\\n``ip_buckets``\\n keyed on a per-boot salted hash of the peer address, used for the anonymous\\n creation budget (``LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_MAX``) and for redirects\\n (``LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_MAX * REDIRECT_LIMIT_MULTIPLIER``).\\n\\n``api_key_buckets``\\n keyed on a per-boot salted hash of a recognised ``X-API-Key`` value, used\\n for that key's own creation quota.\\n\\nEach map is pruned independently at ``LINKS_MAX_TRACKED_KEYS`` entries, so API\\nkey traffic cannot evict per-IP buckets. Identities are never stored or logged\\nin the clear: bucket ids are ``class:blake2s(boot_salt || value)[:16]``.\\n\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\nfrom __future__ import annotations\\n\\nimport hashlib\\nimport logging\\nimport math\\nimport re\\nimport secrets\\nimport threading\\nimport time\\nfrom collections import OrderedDict\\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\\nfrom typing import Callable, Optional, Tuple\\n\\nfrom starlette.responses import JSONResponse\\nfrom starlette.types import ASGIApp, Receive, Scope, Send\\n\\nfrom .config import Settings\\nfrom .errors import error_payload\\n\\nlogger = logging.getLogger(\\\"app.ratelimit\\\")\\n\\n# Redirects are far cheaper than creations and are shared by every visitor of a\\n# link, so the redirect bucket is a large multiple of the creation budget.\\nREDIRECT_LIMIT_MULTIPLIER = 100\\n\\nCREATE_PATH = \\\"/api/links\\\"\\nBUCKET_CLASS_CREATE = \\\"create\\\"\\nBUCKET_CLASS_CREATE_KEY = \\\"create_key\\\"\\nBUCKET_CLASS_REDIRECT = \\\"redirect\\\"\\n\\nAPI_KEY_HEADER = b\\\"x-api-key\\\"\\nMAX_API_KEY_HEADER_LENGTH = 256\\n\\n_REDIRECT_PATH_PATTERN = re.compile(r\\\"^/[0-9A-Za-z_-]{1,64}$\\\")\\n_RESERVED_PATHS = frozenset({\\\"/health\\\", \\\"/docs\\\", \\\"/redoc\\\", \\\"/openapi\\\", \\\"/favicon\\\"})\\n\\n\\ndef _default_clock() -> float:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Return the current monotonic time in seconds.\\n\\n Looked up through the ``time`` module on every call so tests can patch it.\\n Raises nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n return time.monotonic()\\n\\n\\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\\nclass Decision:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Outcome of a limiter check.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n allowed: bool\\n retry_after: int\\n bucket_id: str\\n\\n\\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\\nclass BucketPlan:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Which bucket a request is charged to, and at what limit.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n bucket_class: str\\n identity: str\\n limit: int\\n keyed: bool\\n\\n\\nclass RateLimiterState:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"In-process fixed-window counters shared by every worker thread.\\n\\n State is never serialised to SQLite, the WAL or any file.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n def __init__(self, settings: Settings, clock: Optional[Callable[[], float]] = None) -> None:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Create limiter state for a settings snapshot.\\n\\n ``clock`` is an injectable monotonic time source (defaults to\\n ``time.monotonic``) so tests can advance the window without sleeping.\\n Raises nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n self.settings = settings\\n self.clock: Callable[[], float] = clock if clock is not None else _default_clock\\n self._lock = threading.Lock()\\n self._boot_salt = secrets.token_bytes(16)\\n self.ip_buckets: \\\"OrderedDict[str, Tuple[float, int]]\\\" = OrderedDict()\\n self.api_key_buckets: \\\"OrderedDict[str, Tuple[float, int]]\\\" = OrderedDict()\\n\\n def bucket_id(self, bucket_class: str, identity: str) -> str:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Derive the opaque bucket id for an identity.\\n\\n Returns ``class:digest`` where digest is a truncated blake2s over the\\n per-boot salt and the identity, so neither an API key nor a client\\n address can be recovered from limiter state or logs. Raises nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n digest = hashlib.blake2s(\\n self._boot_salt + identity.encode(\\\"utf-8\\\", \\\"replace\\\")\\n ).hexdigest()[:16]\\n return \\\"%s:%s\\\" % (bucket_class, digest)\\n\\n def _prune(self, buckets: \\\"OrderedDict[str, Tuple[float, int]]\\\") -> None:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Evict least recently used entries beyond the configured cap.\\n\\n Returns None. Raises nothing. Caller must hold the lock.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n limit = self.settings.max_tracked_keys\\n while len(buckets) > limit:\\n buckets.popitem(last=False)\\n\\n def consume(self, plan: BucketPlan) -> Decision:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Charge one request against the planned bucket.\\n\\n Returns a :class:`Decision`; when it is not allowed, ``retry_after`` is\\n a whole number of seconds in ``[1, window]``. Raises nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n buckets = self.api_key_buckets if plan.keyed else self.ip_buckets\\n bucket_id = self.bucket_id(plan.bucket_class, plan.identity)\\n window = float(self.settings.rate_limit_window_seconds)\\n with self._lock:\\n now = float(self.clock())\\n entry = buckets.get(bucket_id)\\n if entry is None or (now - entry[0]) >= window or (now - entry[0]) < 0:\\n buckets[bucket_id] = (now, 1)\\n buckets.move_to_end(bucket_id)\\n self._prune(buckets)\\n return Decision(True, 0, bucket_id)\\n window_start, count = entry\\n if count >= plan.limit:\\n remaining = window - (now - window_start)\\n retry_after = max(1, min(int(window), int(math.ceil(remaining))))\\n return Decision(False, retry_after, bucket_id)\\n buckets[bucket_id] = (window_start, count + 1)\\n buckets.move_to_end(bucket_id)\\n return Decision(True, 0, bucket_id)\\n\\n def advance(self, seconds: float) -> None:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Pretend ``seconds`` have elapsed by rewinding every window start.\\n\\n Intended for tests that must cross a window boundary without sleeping.\\n Returns None. Raises nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n with self._lock:\\n for buckets in (self.ip_buckets, self.api_key_buckets):\\n for bucket_id, (window_start, count) in list(buckets.items()):\\n buckets[bucket_id] = (window_start - seconds, count)\\n\\n def reset(self) -> None:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Drop all counters.\\n\\n Returns None. Raises nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n with self._lock:\\n self.ip_buckets.clear()\\n self.api_key_buckets.clear()\\n\\n\\ndef _header_value(scope: Scope, name: bytes) -> Optional[str]:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Read a single request header from the raw ASGI scope.\\n\\n Returns the trimmed value of the first matching header, or None when the\\n header is absent or undecodable. Raises nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n for raw_name, raw_value in scope.get(\\\"headers\\\") or ():\\n if raw_name == name:\\n try:\\n return raw_value.decode(\\\"latin-1\\\").strip()\\n except (UnicodeDecodeError, AttributeError):\\n return None\\n return None\\n\\n\\ndef _client_identity(scope: Scope) -> str:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Return the peer address used as the per-IP limiter identity.\\n\\n Only the transport peer is used; forwarded headers are ignored because a\\n client can trivially forge them. Returns ``\\\"unknown\\\"`` when the server does\\n not expose a peer. Raises nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n client = scope.get(\\\"client\\\")\\n if client and isinstance(client, (tuple, list)) and client[0]:\\n return str(client[0])\\n return \\\"unknown\\\"\\n\\n\\ndef _is_redirect_path(path: str) -> bool:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Report whether a path is a short-code redirect path.\\n\\n Returns True for single segment code-shaped paths that are not reserved\\n application paths. Raises nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n if not _REDIRECT_PATH_PATTERN.match(path):\\n return False\\n return path not in _RESERVED_PATHS\\n\\n\\nclass RateLimitMiddleware:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"ASGI middleware applying the creation and redirect rate limits.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n def __init__(self, app: ASGIApp, state: RateLimiterState) -> None:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Wrap ``app`` with the limiter backed by ``state``.\\n\\n Raises nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n self.app = app\\n self.state = state\\n\\n def plan(self, scope: Scope) -> Optional[BucketPlan]:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Decide which bucket, if any, this request is charged to.\\n\\n Creation requests presenting a recognised ``X-API-Key`` are charged\\n solely to that key's bucket at that key's quota; every other creation\\n request is charged to the per-IP creation bucket. Redirects are always\\n charged to the per-IP redirect bucket. Returns None for requests that\\n are not rate limited (health, stats, docs, everything else). Raises\\n nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n settings = self.state.settings\\n method = scope.get(\\\"method\\\", \\\"\\\")\\n path = scope.get(\\\"path\\\", \\\"\\\")\\n if method == \\\"POST\\\" and path == CREATE_PATH:\\n quotas = settings.api_key_quotas\\n if quotas:\\n presented = _header_value(scope, API_KEY_HEADER)\\n if (\\n presented\\n and len(presented) <= MAX_API_KEY_HEADER_LENGTH\\n and presented in quotas\\n ):\\n return BucketPlan(\\n bucket_class=BUCKET_CLASS_CREATE_KEY,\\n identity=presented,\\n limit=int(quotas[presented]),\\n keyed=True,\\n )\\n return BucketPlan(\\n bucket_class=BUCKET_CLASS_CREATE,\\n identity=_client_identity(scope),\\n limit=settings.rate_limit_max,\\n keyed=False,\\n )\\n if method in (\\\"GET\\\", \\\"HEAD\\\") and _is_redirect_path(path):\\n return BucketPlan(\\n bucket_class=BUCKET_CLASS_REDIRECT,\\n identity=_client_identity(scope),\\n limit=settings.rate_limit_max * REDIRECT_LIMIT_MULTIPLIER,\\n keyed=False,\\n )\\n return None\\n\\n async def __call__(self, scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Apply the limit and either forward the request or answer with 429.\\n\\n Returns None. Raises whatever the wrapped application raises.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n if scope.get(\\\"type\\\") != \\\"http\\\" or not self.state.settings.rate_limit_enabled:\\n await self.app(scope, receive, send)\\n return\\n\\n plan = self.plan(scope)\\n if plan is None:\\n await self.app(scope, receive, send)\\n return\\n\\n decision = self.state.consume(plan)\\n logger.debug(\\n \\\"rate limit check bucket=%s allowed=%s\\\", decision.bucket_id, decision.allowed\\n )\\n if decision.allowed:\\n await self.app(scope, receive, send)\\n return\\n\\n response = JSONResponse(\\n status_code=429,\\n content=error_payload(\\n \\\"rate_limited\\\", \\\"Rate limit exceeded. Please retry later.\\\"\\n ),\\n headers={\\n \\\"Retry-After\\\": str(decision.retry_after),\\n \\\"Cache-Control\\\": \\\"no-store\\\",\\n },\\n )\\n await response(scope, receive, send)\\n\"},{\"path\":\"app/main.py\",\"content\":\"\\\"\\\"\\\"FastAPI application: link creation, redirects, stats and health.\\n\\nRedirect destinations always come from the validated value stored in SQLite;\\nno query parameter, header or path segment of an incoming request can influence\\na ``Location``.\\n\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\nfrom __future__ import annotations\\n\\nimport logging\\nimport sqlite3\\nimport time\\nfrom datetime import timedelta\\nfrom typing import Callable, Dict, Optional\\n\\nfrom fastapi import FastAPI, Request\\nfrom fastapi.exceptions import RequestValidationError\\nfrom fastapi.responses import JSONResponse, RedirectResponse\\nfrom starlette.exceptions import HTTPException as StarletteHTTPException\\n\\nfrom .config import Settings, load_settings\\nfrom .db import MAX_TEXT_FIELD_LENGTH, connect, fetch_link, init_db, insert_link, record_click\\nfrom .errors import AppError, error_response\\nfrom .models import CreateLinkRequest, CreateLinkResponse, HealthResponse, StatsResponse\\nfrom .ratelimit import RateLimiterState, RateLimitMiddleware\\nfrom .urls import InvalidURLError, validate_target_url\\nfrom .utils import CODE_PATTERN, generate_code, to_rfc3339, truncate, utc_now\\n\\nlogger = logging.getLogger(\\\"app.main\\\")\\n\\n_HTTP_ERROR_CODES: Dict[int, str] = {\\n 400: \\\"bad_request\\\",\\n 401: \\\"unauthorized\\\",\\n 403: \\\"forbidden\\\",\\n 404: \\\"not_found\\\",\\n 405: \\\"method_not_allowed\\\",\\n 409: \\\"conflict\\\",\\n 410: \\\"gone\\\",\\n 413: \\\"payload_too_large\\\",\\n 415: \\\"unsupported_media_type\\\",\\n 422: \\\"validation_error\\\",\\n 429: \\\"rate_limited\\\",\\n 500: \\\"internal_error\\\",\\n 503: \\\"service_unavailable\\\",\\n}\\n\\n\\ndef configure_logging(level_name: str) -> None:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Apply the configured log level to the root and application loggers.\\n\\n Returns None. Raises nothing; an unknown level degrades to INFO.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n level = getattr(logging, level_name.upper(), logging.INFO)\\n if not isinstance(level, int):\\n level = logging.INFO\\n logging.basicConfig(level=level)\\n logging.getLogger().setLevel(level)\\n logging.getLogger(\\\"app\\\").setLevel(level)\\n\\n\\ndef _settings_of(request: Request) -> Settings:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Return the frozen settings snapshot attached to the running app.\\n\\n Raises AppError(500) when the application was not constructed correctly.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n settings = getattr(request.app.state, \\\"settings\\\", None)\\n if not isinstance(settings, Settings):\\n raise AppError(500, \\\"internal_error\\\", \\\"The service is not configured.\\\")\\n return settings\\n\\n\\ndef _is_expired(expires_at: Optional[str], now_iso: str) -> bool:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Report whether a stored expiry timestamp has passed.\\n\\n Both values are fixed width RFC3339 UTC strings, so the lexicographic\\n comparison is chronological. NULL means the link never expires. Returns the\\n comparison result. Raises nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n if not expires_at:\\n return False\\n return expires_at <= now_iso\\n\\n\\ndef create_app(\\n settings: Optional[Settings] = None,\\n clock: Optional[Callable[[], float]] = None,\\n) -> FastAPI:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Build the FastAPI application.\\n\\n ``settings`` defaults to a snapshot read from the process environment and\\n ``clock`` to ``time.monotonic``; both exist so tests can drive the limiter\\n deterministically. Returns the configured application. Raises sqlite3.Error\\n or OSError when the database cannot be initialised.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n active = settings if settings is not None else load_settings()\\n configure_logging(active.log_level)\\n init_db(active.db_path)\\n\\n app = FastAPI(\\n title=\\\"URL Shortener\\\",\\n version=\\\"1.1.0\\\",\\n description=\\\"Short links with SSRF-hardened targets and per-key creation quotas.\\\",\\n )\\n app.state.settings = active\\n limiter = RateLimiterState(active, clock if clock is not None else time.monotonic)\\n app.state.rate_limiter = limiter\\n app.add_middleware(RateLimitMiddleware, state=limiter)\\n\\n @app.exception_handler(AppError)\\n async def handle_app_error(request: Request, exc: AppError) -> JSONResponse:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Render an application error in the stable envelope.\\n\\n Returns the JSON error response. Raises nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n return error_response(exc.status_code, exc.code, exc.message, exc.headers)\\n\\n @app.exception_handler(RequestValidationError)\\n async def handle_validation_error(\\n request: Request, exc: RequestValidationError\\n ) -> JSONResponse:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Render a boundary validation failure as 422 validation_error.\\n\\n Only field locations and messages are echoed, never submitted values.\\n Returns the JSON error response. Raises nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n details = []\\n for error in exc.errors()[:5]:\\n location = \\\".\\\".join(\\n str(part) for part in error.get(\\\"loc\\\", ()) if part not in (\\\"body\\\",)\\n )\\n details.append(\\n \\\"%s: %s\\\" % (location or \\\"body\\\", error.get(\\\"msg\\\", \\\"invalid value\\\"))\\n )\\n message = \\\"; \\\".join(details) or \\\"The request body failed validation.\\\"\\n return error_response(422, \\\"validation_error\\\", message)\\n\\n @app.exception_handler(StarletteHTTPException)\\n async def handle_http_exception(\\n request: Request, exc: StarletteHTTPException\\n ) -> JSONResponse:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Render framework HTTP errors in the stable envelope.\\n\\n Returns the JSON error response. Raises nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n code = _HTTP_ERROR_CODES.get(exc.status_code, \\\"http_error\\\")\\n detail = exc.detail if isinstance(exc.detail, str) and exc.detail else \\\"Request failed.\\\"\\n headers = getattr(exc, \\\"headers\\\", None)\\n return error_response(exc.status_code, code, detail, headers)\\n\\n @app.exception_handler(Exception)\\n async def handle_unexpected_error(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> JSONResponse:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Render any unhandled error as a generic 500.\\n\\n The detail is logged server side only. Returns the JSON error response.\\n Raises nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n logger.exception(\\\"unhandled error while serving a request\\\")\\n return error_response(500, \\\"internal_error\\\", \\\"An unexpected error occurred.\\\")\\n\\n @app.get(\\\"/health\\\", response_model=HealthResponse, tags=[\\\"ops\\\"])\\n def health() -> HealthResponse:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Report process liveness without touching user data.\\n\\n Returns a small status document. Raises nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n return HealthResponse(\\n status=\\\"ok\\\", service=\\\"url-shortener\\\", time=to_rfc3339(utc_now())\\n )\\n\\n @app.post(\\n \\\"/api/links\\\",\\n response_model=CreateLinkResponse,\\n status_code=201,\\n tags=[\\\"links\\\"],\\n )\\n def create_link(payload: CreateLinkRequest, request: Request) -> CreateLinkResponse:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Create a short link for a validated http(s) target.\\n\\n Returns the created link with its short URL and expiry. Raises AppError\\n with 422 validation_error for out-of-range input, 400 invalid_url for a\\n target that fails URL policy, and 503 code_generation_failed when no\\n free short code could be allocated.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n settings = _settings_of(request)\\n raw_url = payload.url.strip()\\n if len(raw_url) > settings.max_url_length:\\n raise AppError(\\n 422,\\n \\\"validation_error\\\",\\n \\\"url must be at most %d characters.\\\" % settings.max_url_length,\\n )\\n try:\\n target_url = validate_target_url(raw_url, settings.max_url_length)\\n except InvalidURLError as exc:\\n raise AppError(400, \\\"invalid_url\\\", str(exc)) from exc\\n\\n if payload.ttl_seconds is not None:\\n ttl = payload.ttl_seconds\\n if ttl > settings.max_ttl_seconds:\\n raise AppError(\\n 422,\\n \\\"validation_error\\\",\\n \\\"ttl_seconds must be at most %d.\\\" % settings.max_ttl_seconds,\\n )\\n else:\\n ttl = min(settings.default_ttl_seconds, settings.max_ttl_seconds)\\n\\n created = utc_now()\\n created_at = to_rfc3339(created)\\n expires_at = to_rfc3339(created + timedelta(seconds=ttl)) if ttl > 0 else None\\n\\n code: Optional[str] = None\\n with connect(settings.db_path) as conn:\\n for _ in range(settings.code_max_attempts):\\n candidate = generate_code(settings.code_length)\\n try:\\n insert_link(conn, candidate, target_url, created_at, expires_at)\\n except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\\n logger.warning(\\\"short code collision; retrying\\\")\\n continue\\n code = candidate\\n break\\n\\n if code is None:\\n raise AppError(\\n 503,\\n \\\"code_generation_failed\\\",\\n \\\"Could not allocate a unique short code. Please retry.\\\",\\n )\\n\\n return CreateLinkResponse(\\n code=code,\\n short_url=\\\"%s/%s\\\" % (settings.base_url, code),\\n target_url=target_url,\\n created_at=created_at,\\n expires_at=expires_at,\\n )\\n\\n @app.get(\\n \\\"/api/links/{code}/stats\\\",\\n response_model=StatsResponse,\\n tags=[\\\"links\\\"],\\n )\\n def link_stats(code: str, request: Request) -> StatsResponse:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Return click statistics for a stored link.\\n\\n Returns the stats document. Raises AppError with 404 not_found when the\\n code is unknown or malformed and 410 link_expired when the link's TTL\\n has passed.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n settings = _settings_of(request)\\n if not CODE_PATTERN.match(code):\\n raise AppError(404, \\\"not_found\\\", \\\"Short link not found.\\\")\\n now_iso = to_rfc3339(utc_now())\\n with connect(settings.db_path) as conn:\\n row = fetch_link(conn, code)\\n if row is None:\\n raise AppError(404, \\\"not_found\\\", \\\"Short link not found.\\\")\\n if _is_expired(row[\\\"expires_at\\\"], now_iso):\\n raise AppError(410, \\\"link_expired\\\", \\\"This short link has expired.\\\")\\n return StatsResponse(\\n code=str(row[\\\"code\\\"]),\\n target_url=str(row[\\\"target_url\\\"]),\\n created_at=str(row[\\\"created_at\\\"]),\\n expires_at=row[\\\"expires_at\\\"],\\n click_count=int(row[\\\"click_count\\\"]),\\n last_clicked_at=row[\\\"last_clicked_at\\\"],\\n )\\n\\n @app.get(\\\"/{code}\\\", include_in_schema=False)\\n def follow(code: str, request: Request) -> RedirectResponse:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Redirect to the stored target for a short code.\\n\\n The destination is always the value validated at creation time and read\\n back from the database. Returns a 307 redirect. Raises AppError with\\n 404 not_found for an unknown or malformed code and 410 link_expired for\\n an expired link.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n settings = _settings_of(request)\\n if not CODE_PATTERN.match(code):\\n raise AppError(404, \\\"not_found\\\", \\\"Short link not found.\\\")\\n now = utc_now()\\n now_iso = to_rfc3339(now)\\n with connect(settings.db_path) as conn:\\n row = fetch_link(conn, code)\\n if row is None:\\n raise AppError(404, \\\"not_found\\\", \\\"Short link not found.\\\")\\n if _is_expired(row[\\\"expires_at\\\"], now_iso):\\n raise AppError(410, \\\"link_expired\\\", \\\"This short link has expired.\\\")\\n target_url = str(row[\\\"target_url\\\"])\\n record_click(\\n conn,\\n int(row[\\\"id\\\"]),\\n now_iso,\\n truncate(request.headers.get(\\\"referer\\\"), MAX_TEXT_FIELD_LENGTH),\\n truncate(request.headers.get(\\\"user-agent\\\"), MAX_TEXT_FIELD_LENGTH),\\n )\\n return RedirectResponse(\\n url=target_url,\\n status_code=307,\\n headers={\\\"Cache-Control\\\": \\\"no-store\\\"},\\n )\\n\\n return app\\n\\n\\napp = create_app()\\n\"}],\"notes\":\"Design gaps I had to close, and the choices made:\\n\\n1. Expired links. The design text supplied was truncated and never states the expired-link response. Both GET /{code} and GET /api/links/{code}/stats return 410 with {\\\"error\\\":{\\\"code\\\":\\\"link_expired\\\",...}} once expires_at <= now; unknown/malformed codes return 404 not_found. Expiry is checked on every read (never only at creation) by comparing fixed-width RFC3339 UTC strings, which is why to_rfc3339 always emits 6-digit microseconds and a trailing Z: lexicographic order equals chronological order, matching the data-model note.\\n\\n2. Invalid target URLs. Body-shape problems (missing/oversized/wrong-typed fields, url longer than LINKS_MAX_URL_LENGTH) are 422 validation_error as the design says. URL *policy* failures (non-http(s) scheme, embedded credentials, unresolvable host, host resolving to loopback/private/link-local/multicast/reserved/unspecified/metadata) are 400 invalid_url, because they are semantically correct JSON that policy forbids. Both use the stable envelope.\\n\\n3. Host resolution is strict: if getaddrinfo fails the URL is rejected. No resolution cache is used, deliberately, so a test that monkeypatches socket.getaddrinfo always sees its patched result. 169.254.169.254 (and fd00:ec2::254) are denied by name in addition to the range checks, IPv4-mapped/6to4 IPv6 addresses are unwrapped before checking, and anything that is not ip.is_global is rejected as a catch-all.\\n\\n4. Rate limiting matches the design exactly: one ASGI middleware ahead of routing/body parsing, separate ip_buckets and api_key_buckets OrderedDicts each pruned independently at LINKS_MAX_TRACKED_KEYS, bucket ids of the form class:blake2s(boot_salt||value)[:16] with a 16-byte per-process salt, redirects at LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_MAX * 100 on the 'redirect' per-IP bucket only, stats and /health never limited. A recognised X-API-Key charges only 'create_key' at that key's quota; unknown/absent keys charge 'create' per IP; no 401/403 anywhere. Retry-After is a whole-second decimal string clamped to [1, window] and every 429 also carries Cache-Control: no-store. Key values are never persisted, logged (only the class+digest is logged at DEBUG) or echoed.\\n\\n5. Test hooks the design implies but does not name: create_app(settings=..., clock=...) and app.state.rate_limiter, which exposes a reassignable .clock attribute plus advance(seconds) and reset() so a window boundary can be crossed without sleeping. The default clock indirects through the time module on each call, so monkeypatching time.monotonic also works.\\n\\n6. Per-IP identity is the ASGI transport peer only; X-Forwarded-For is deliberately ignored because a client can forge it.\\n\\n7. Config: only the 13 documented variables are read, with their exact names and defaults. Extra hard ceilings (e.g. url length <= 8192, window <= 3600, api-key quota <= 1_000_000) sit on top of the defaults so a hostile environment cannot push the process into a pathological range; every unusable value degrades to the documented default with a warning that never includes the offending SHORTENER_API_KEYS text (it may be a credential) \\\\u2014 only a count of skipped entries is logged.\\n\\n8. requirements.txt pins the required runtime versions and additionally pins httpx and pytest, which starlette.testclient needs at import time. They are test tooling, not service imports; the service imports nothing outside the stdlib, FastAPI, Starlette and pydantic.\\n\\nReviewer: start with app/ratelimit.py (bucket selection and the 429 path) and app/urls.py (scheme allow-list, credential rejection, address checks), then app/main.py's expiry checks.\"}", "tier": "deep"}
